dogecoin.text: As of March 2020, Dogecoin's power usage was ~3.7% of Bitcoin's, according to this paper. I would guess that probably means it fails Musk's criterion that an acceptable cryptocurrency should use <1% of Bitcoin's energy per transaction. https://t.co/hMy28u0g38
Elon Musk abandons Bitcoin. Is Dogecoin now going to succeed as the climate-friendly alternative?
